transport.measurement: Command creation to observer event callback; excludes browser canvas rendering
transport.network: application-emulated delay, not physical network shaping
transport.baseMeasurement: Server/network receive timestamp minus actual socket emit timestamp
transport.emulatedMeasurement: Delayed observer callback timestamp minus command creation timestamp
transport.clock: shared monotonic performance.now across independent client sessions in one process

limitations: Node clients do not measure browser rendering or mobile CPU.
Application delays emulate latency only, not network jitter, bandwidth limits, loss or congestion.
Same-host client/server/database runs compete for CPU and memory; report the actual deployment topology separately.
CPU budget defaults to one logical core; LOAD_CPU_CORES must match an enforced or explicitly documented server allocation.
A passing short run is a screening result; only at least ten minutes qualifies a capacity estimate.
Retained rooms from previous runs contaminate memory/room counts: restart the isolated benchmark server/database between runs.

benchmarkEnvironment.topology: Host Node25.5.0 load generator; Node24 server and MongoDB in separate CPU/memory-limited Docker Desktop containers on the same Mac; direct server port5100 bypasses Next.js/Caddy.
benchmarkEnvironment.storage: Docker Desktop named volume; host storage was not isolated or independently benchmarked.
